title: Providing ChatGPT to the Entire U.S. Federal Workforce
summary: Today, OpenAI for Government is announcing a new partnership with the U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) to launch a transformative initiative. For the next year, ChatGPT Enterprise will be available to the entire federal executive branch workforce at essentially no cost.
body: Today, OpenAI for Government is announcing a new partnership with the U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) to launch a transformative initiative. For the next year, ChatGPT Enterprise will be available to the entire federal executive branch workforce at essentially no cost.
summaryZh: 为整个美国联邦工作人员提供 ChatGPT。今天，OpenAI for Government 宣布与美国总务管理局 (GSA) 建立新的合作伙伴关系，以启动一项变革性举措。明年，ChatGPT Enterprise 将基本免费向所有联邦行政部门员工开放。
